review.note: report: string_to_double_fuzzer on crash-ee4856... (strtod.cc assertion); no dataset file has that SHA-1; exploit.sh runs the unit tests

category5.design: The injected code lets DoubleStrtod take the exact-double fast path for up to 115 trimmed digits instead of 15, so a long decimal trips the assertion read_digits==trimmed.length(). The dataset's crash file was not saved; a sibling task that mutates the same line left a saved crash input that triggers this bug on string_to_double_fuzzer.
